does: Captures the intensity of physical struggle through dynamic, overlapping forms.
Uses dramatic lighting to emphasize the muscular tension and sweat of the fighters.
refuses: Depicting the scene with calm or static poses.
Using soft or pastel colors to create a serene atmosphere.
reading.tension: The chaotic energy of the fight contrasts with the focused, almost voyeuristic gaze of the audience.
materialFacts: Thick, expressive brushstrokes define the figures and their movements.
The background is dark and loosely rendered, pushing the action forward.
structuralMoves: The composition centers on the fighters, with their bodies forming a diagonal axis.
The crowd is cropped at the bottom, creating a sense of immediacy and immersion.
